title: PANEM — Digital Agency | SEO · Google Ads · SMM · Target

analysis.business_context: Digital marketing agency emphasizing SEO, Google Ads, SMM, and performance marketing for business growth—targeting companies seeking to improve online visibility and results.
analysis.audience: Business owners, marketing managers, and company decision-makers looking to scale their digital presence.
analysis.conversion_goal: Primary goal is to encourage visitors to request a free audit or consultation via prominent CTAs.
analysis.first_viewport_logic: Hero section uses large, bold typography combined with a minimalist, high-contrast dark style to immediately communicate core value proposition ('Grow Faster'), supported by brief service descriptors above the fold. Navigation is immediate and fixed; CTA in header is visually distinct.
information_architecture: Top navigation: Services, Cases, Projects, About Us, Blog, Contacts
Hero section with service proposition and headline
Service categories in a horizontal scroll/carousel
Selected case study or featured success metrics
List of services and performance results
Feature icons to highlight agency strengths
Footer with secondary navigation and legal info
Contact form section at the bottom
analysis.narrative_storytelling: Narrative centers on boosting client growth, using concise copy and a progression of social proof, success stats, and service clarity. Case study modules and visual stats reinforce results-driven outcomes.
analysis.composition_grid: Strict modular grid with clear column/gutter structure. Design aligns left with center-columned content and visual sections spanning the full width for contrast breaks. Consistent separation between major bands of content.
analysis.spacing_rhythm: Generous vertical whitespace between blocks provides a sense of calm and hierarchy. Section paddings are wide, enabling legibility and focus; content isn't crowded, but elements within bands (e.g., stats) are grouped tightly for association.
analysis.typography: Bold, heavy sans-serif headlines contrast with lightweight, smaller navigation and body text. All-caps in hero for impact. Clear typographic scale differentiates headings, stats, and legal/footnote details. Minimal decorative fonts, strictly modern sans-serif family.
analysis.palette_contrast: High-contrast dark background (black/deep gray) with white or near-white text. Call to actions (CTAs) use white or colored backgrounds for stand-out effect. The palette is stark, clean, and contemporary, with minimal accent coloring for links or action elements only.
analysis.media_treatment: Minimal imagery—focus on text and blocks. Placeholder for case study image/video, set in a black or gray surround. Abstract or absent backgrounds avoid distraction; iconography in features follows a fine-outline, monochrome style for consistency.
analysis.motion_interaction: Subtle hover effects on navigation and buttons (e.g., underline or highlight). Fixed/sticky header detail with CTA. Section transitions are likely simple fades or slides (not visible on static screenshot). Horizontal scrolling service menu hints at interactive behavior.
analysis.cta_strategy: CTAs appear in the header (fixed position for immediate access), mid-page (case study box) and prominently in the contact section/final module. Designed with a stark contrasting background, centered, and large enough to be immediately actionable—language is direct ('Get a Free Audit').
analysis.desktop_behavior: Persistent header with navigation and CTA. Wide lateral spacing; horizontal menu for services; large inline modules. Content flows in clear horizontal bands—no overlap or crowding. Background textures/grids are more visible on desktop due to size.
analysis.mobile_behavior: Single-column flow; navigation collapses into a hamburger or top-strapped stack. All content stacks vertically with compressed, touch-friendly service menu. Spacing is reduced but remains readable. All CTAs and forms sized for easy touch without requiring zoom.
learn: Hero sections can use heavy contrast and overlarge typography to anchor perception of brand strength and clarity.
Strict monochrome palettes build focus and communicate professionalism without visual clutter.
Persistent, visually-distinct CTAs in header and footer improve conversion accessibility across device types.
Case studies or stat blocks should be paired with quantitative measures to build credibility quickly.
do_not_copy: Do not leave imagery blank—use a purposeful image or graphic where placeholders exist; blank blocks can reduce polish.
Avoid extreme text contrast without sufficient line height or whitespace; make sure readability remains high in all sections.
Do not bury or minimize CTAs in dense or low-contrast areas; they must always stand out and be accessible throughout the scroll.
reusable_cross_category_traits: Bold typographic hero with immediate value statement.
Section-based, high-contrast monochrome backgrounds to segment journey.
Use of performance metrics/case studies as social proof anchors.
traits: Emphasis on quantifiable results via case studies and stats.
Clear vertical sectioning and progressive content disclosure.
Mobile-first, with excellent stacking and touch targets.
Fixed navigation and easily locatable contact points.
